systems.system: Ethio telecom national backbone fibre network
systems.tiers: national, 23,442.1 km after 793 km added in 2025/26; no local government office said to be on it

systems.system: Ethio telecom data centres and TeleCloud
systems.tiers: six Tier III-certified facilities in Addis Ababa and regional locations, said to support more than 880 government entities, unnamed and with no tier given

systems.system: Ethio telecom rural mobile network expansion
systems.tiers: 195 new rural mobile sites covering 117 woredas and 492 villages or kebeles; public mobile coverage, no woreda office said to be on it

note: The operator's annual report counts woredas as areas reached by mobile coverage (117) and by national ID registration (986, 79 per cent); it says fibre serves government institutions and its data centres support more than 880 government entities, without naming any local government office, tier or count of offices connected.
